mechanism: Propylthiouracil may reduce CoQ10 synthesis by inhibiting mevalonate pathway enzymes involved in thyroid hormone metabolism, and CoQ10 supplementation may theoretically enhance cellular antioxidant capacity in PTU-induced hepatotoxicity.
action: Monitor hepatic function and consider CoQ10 supplementation cautiously as it may provide hepatoprotective benefits during PTU therapy, but lacks definitive evidence for routine use.
